question: The Indo-American scientist Har Gobind Khorana won the Noble prize for his contribution in _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**genetics**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Har Gobind Khorana was an Indo-American scientist who was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine in 1968.
 
• He received the prize for his work on the interpretation of the genetic code and its function in protein synthesis.
 
• His pioneering research helped to understand how nucleotides in nucleic acids control the synthesis of proteins in cells.
 
• Khorana's work was fundamental in the field of genetics, contributing significantly to molecular biology and biotechnology.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Genetics:**

 
 
• Genetics is the study of genes, genetic variation, and heredity in organisms.
 
• It plays a crucial role in understanding the biological processes that govern the development and functioning of living organisms.
 
• Genetic research has applications in medicine, agriculture, and numerous other fields.
 
• Advancements in genetics have led to the development of genetic engineering, gene therapy, and personalized medicine.
 
 
 
• **Nobel Prize:**
 
 
• The Nobel Prize is a set of prestigious international awards given annually in several categories, including Physiology or Medicine, Physics, Chemistry, Literature, and Peace.
 
• It was established by the will of Alfred Nobel, the inventor of dynamite, in 1895.
 
• The Nobel Prizes are widely regarded as the most prestigious awards available in their respective fields.
 
 
 
• **Protein Synthesis:**
 
 
• Protein synthesis is the process through which cells build proteins based on the genetic instructions carried by mRNA (messenger RNA).
 
• The process involves two main stages: transcription (DNA to RNA) and translation (RNA to protein).
 
• Ribosomes play a key role in translating the genetic code into proteins.
 
 
 
• **Molecular Biology:**
 
 
• Molecular biology is a branch of biology that deals with the molecular basis of biological activity between biomolecules in various systems of a cell.
 
• This field overlaps with genetics and biochemistry and focuses on understanding the interactions between various cell systems, including the interactions of DNA, RNA, and protein synthesis.
